title.zh: Anthropic递交IPO申请 上半年营收163亿美元
title.en: Anthropic files for IPO, reporting $16.3B first-half revenue

summary.zh: Anthropic提交S-1文件拟在纳斯达克上市，披露上半年营收163亿美元、营业亏损6.93亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic filed an S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO, reporting $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and a $693 million operating loss.

body.zh:
据[《卫报》](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/oct/26/ai-cloud-computing-companies-guppy-level-death-elon-musk-stock-markets-dollar-oil-bond-yieds-latest-news-updates)报道，Anthropic于10月26日提交上市申请。据DailyAI汇总，S-1文件显示公司上半年营收163亿美元，营业亏损6.93亿美元，计划在纳斯达克上市。

同日Meta宣布950亿美元股票发行计划，AI巨头融资潮进一步升温。
body.en:
The [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/oct/26/ai-cloud-computing-companies-guppy-level-death-elon-musk-stock-markets-dollar-oil-bond-yieds-latest-news-updates) reported Anthropic filed for its IPO on Oct. 26. Per [DailyAI](https://dailyai.com/2026/10/dai60-anthropics-books-metas-hat-and-a-cheaper-terra/), the S-1 shows $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and a $693 million operating loss, with a Nasdaq listing planned.

Meta announced a $95 billion stock offering the same day.

title.zh: OpenAI推出更便宜的计算机使用模型GPT-6.1 Terra
title.en: OpenAI launches cheaper computer-use model GPT-6.1 Terra

summary.zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.1 Terra，每百万token输入1美元、输出5美元，面向计算机使用场景。
summary.en: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper computer-use model at $1/$5 per million input/output tokens.

title.zh: 卢拉赢得巴西总统决选 弗拉维奥·博索纳罗称将寻求宣布无效
title.en: Lula wins Brazil runoff; Flavio Bolsonaro seeks annulment

summary.zh: 卢拉以51.76%对48.24%击败弗拉维奥·博索纳罗赢得连任，后者表示将寻求宣布选举无效。
summary.en: Lula won Brazil's runoff with 51.76% to Flavio Bolsonaro's 48.24%; Bolsonaro said he would seek an annulment.

body.zh:
据阿纳多卢通讯社报道，在10月25日举行的巴西总统决选中，现任总统卢拉获得51.76%的有效票，击败获得48.24%的参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。

弗拉维奥在首轮以47.08%对45.10%领先，但决选中被反超。他表示将寻求宣布选举结果无效。受此影响，巴西资产10月26日大幅下跌。
body.en:
Per [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/morning-briefing-oct-26-2026/4100631), President Lula won the Oct. 25 runoff with 51.76% of valid votes against Flavio Bolsonaro's 48.24%.

Flavio had led the first round 47.08% to 45.10%. He said he would seek an annulment. Brazilian assets fell sharply on Oct. 26.

title.zh: 塞尔维亚提前大选 武契奇承认其名单落败
title.en: Vucic concedes his list lost Serbia's snap election

summary.zh: 塞尔维亚总统武契奇承认其支持的名单在提前议会选举中落败；特朗普重申支持内塔尼亚胡。
summary.en: Serbian President Vucic conceded his list lost the snap parliamentary election; Trump reaffirmed support for Netanyahu.

title.zh: Meta计划发行950亿美元股票为AI扩张融资
title.en: Meta plans $95 billion stock offering to fund AI

summary.zh: Meta宣布950亿美元股票发行计划，用于AI基础设施和“超级智能”，英伟达、AMD和博通有意认购至多50亿美元。
summary.en: Meta announced a $95 billion stock offering for AI infrastructure; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom are interested in up to $5 billion.

title.zh: 美股收涨 巴西资产因卢拉胜选重挫
title.en: Wall Street rises as Brazil sinks after Lula win

summary.zh: 10月26日标普500涨0.70%，纳指涨0.82%，Anthropic上市申请提振科技股；巴西市场大跌。
summary.en: The S&P 500 rose 0.70% and the Nasdaq 0.82% on Oct. 26 as Anthropic's filing lifted tech, while Brazilian markets slumped.

title.zh: 国务院公布《事业单位登记管理条例》
title.en: State Council issues public institution registration rules

summary.zh: 李强签署国务院令，公布《事业单位登记管理条例》；二十届中央第八轮巡视完成进驻。
summary.en: Li Qiang signed a State Council decree issuing new public institution registration rules; the eighth inspection round began.

summary.zh: 《新闻联播》报道，全国1.6万个老旧小区完成改造；长三角货物贸易进出口连续19个月增长。
summary.en: CCTV reported 16,000 old communities renovated and Yangtze River Delta goods trade growing for 19 straight months.

title.zh: 央行设立债市非银机构大额赎回互换便利
title.en: PBOC sets up swap facility for bond fund redemptions

summary.zh: 央行设立债券市场非银机构大额赎回互换便利；商务部就商业秘密保护规定征求意见。
summary.en: The PBOC created a swap facility for large redemptions by non-bank bond investors; Commerce sought comment on trade-secret rules.
